lede: Georgia carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.1 against +6.0, a 4.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Georgia -16.7 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Georgia winning 87% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is qb room, where Georgia leads Vanderbilt by 104 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
